official_onet_description: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.
official_esco_description: Give attention to what other people say, patiently understand points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times; able to listen carefully the needs of customers, clients, passengers, service users or others, and provide solutions accordingly.
human_approval_notes: Both definitions cover attentive listening, understanding a speaker and responding or asking questions; strong concept equivalence.

official_onet_description: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.
official_esco_description: Make and defend judgements based on internal evidence and external criteria. Critically evaluate the credibility and reliability of information before using or passing it on to others. Develop independent and critical thinking.
human_approval_notes: Both concern reasoning and critical assessment of evidence to make defensible judgments; minor differences in phrasing do not change core concept.

official_onet_description: Teaching others how to do something.
official_esco_description: Guide or teach others by providing relevant knowledge and support.
human_approval_notes: Both involve teaching or guiding others how to perform an activity or acquire practical knowledge.

official_onet_description: Performing routine maintenance on equipment and determining when and what kind of maintenance is needed.
official_esco_description: Regularly inspect and perform all required activities to maintain the equipment in functional order prior or after its use.
human_approval_notes: Both include routine inspection/upkeep of equipment; O*NET adds deciding timing/type of maintenance. Closely aligned.

official_onet_description: Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it.
official_esco_description: Identify operating problems, decide what to do about it and report accordingly.
human_approval_notes: Both identify operating problems and determine corrective action; directly aligned.

official_onet_description: Conducting tests and inspections of products, services, or processes to evaluate quality or performance.
official_esco_description: Conduct inspections and tests of services, processes, or products to evaluate quality.
human_approval_notes: Both concern inspecting/testing products, services or processes to assess quality and performance.

official_onet_description: Determining how a system should work and how changes in conditions, operations, and the environment will affect outcomes.
official_esco_description: Execute system analyses and calculate to what extent changes could affect outcomes.
human_approval_notes: Both analyze systems and consider effects of changed conditions; check any domain-specific constraints during final review.

official_onet_description: Managing one's own time and the time of others.
official_esco_description: Plan the time sequence of events, programmes and activities, as well as the work of others.
human_approval_notes: Both cover planning or managing time and sequencing activities; ESCO is operationally phrased but the core time-management skill aligns.
